# 1 Enoch Chapter 87 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams — Animal Apocalypse

---

**1** I saw one of those four white figures [the archangels] emerge from that place, and three others came with it.

**2** Three of them took hold of my hands and lifted me away from the human world, raising me to a high place [Enoch's visionary ascent]. From there they showed me a tower rising high above the earth, with all the hills lying far below.

**3** One of them said to me: "Stay here and watch everything that happens to those elephants, camels, and donkeys [the giants], the stars [the Watchers], the cattle, and all the rest."

**4** Then I watched one of those four white figures [an archangel] seize the first star that had fallen from heaven [Semyaza, leader of the Watchers] and bind it hand and foot and throw it into an abyss. The abyss was narrow, deep, terrifying, and completely dark.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Chapter 87 shows the four archangels (white figures) taking action against the fallen Watchers. SYMBOLISM: four white figures = the four archangels (Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Phanuel/Uriel); Enoch lifted up = his visionary ascent to observe history from above (cf. ch. 14); the first star bound = Semyaza (cf. 1 En 10:11-13: 'Bind Semyaza and his companions in the valleys of the earth'); the narrow dark abyss = the place of punishment for fallen angels.*
